body:
I assume `_is_vi_visible` can only be true if we _are_ a visual instance?
Then perhaps we can skip the somewhat costly casting step:

```suggestion
		if (_is_vi_visible() && data.fti_global_xform_interp_set) {
```
I guess this would be fixed with your other PR https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/107324? Maybe we should move forward with that first?
Where would it be stored? `data.global_transform_interpolated`? I guess the downside would be needing to set a flag that it's been calculated for this frame already?

I don't think we can, because presently the `_is_vi_visible()` only tells us that visual instances are visible, it will still return true for `Spatials` that are invisible, and we don't want this branch taken in that case.

This is something that will be solved shortly once the `is_visible_in_tree()` optimization PR is merged, as we can simplify this logic to just use a single `is_visible_in_tree()` check.

We do need this PR though for betas in the meantime, unless we choose to merge the 4.x `visible_in_tree` optimization asap, in which case I can change.

Essentially you are correct, we should eventually make this more efficient, yes, but it won't be too bad in the meantime (it would probably not make measurable difference in most games).

Yes, as said above, that would be ideal, but this PR is a release blocker, whereas the other PR is an optimization (and in 4.x, it depends on us sorting out quick access to children, which we still haven't finalized).

Yes, it would need some logic.
If required, it would be better as a follow up imo.

This current version fixes the pressing release block, deciding whether to cache or not is something to push down the road.
